profiles.i18n_desc: Linux kernel driver for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S accessories (Recommended)
profiles.i18n_desc[en_US]: Linux kernel driver for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S accessories (Recommended)
profiles.check_script: rpm -q xone && rpm -q lpf-xone-firmware && rpm -q xone-firmware
profiles.install_script: dnf install -y "dnf5-command(builddep)" && dnf install -y lpf-xone-firmware xone && if ! rpm -q xone-firmware; then lpf reset xone-firmware && yes | PAGER=cat lpf -n approve xone-firmware && lpf -n build xone-firmware && lpf -n install xone-firmware; fi && if [ -x /usr/bin/nobara-eac-kmods ]; then /usr/bin/nobara-eac-kmods || true; fi
profiles.remove_script: dnf remove -y lpf-xone-firmware xone xone-firmware xpad-noone
